scope: MiniVectorDB Agent Prompt iteration history. Each version adds only rules that a real failure or a real misjudgement forced. The assistant wrote and ran the implementation, the validation and the experiments; the single student technical judgement is attributed separately in conversation.json.

versions.title: 读题包先于写代码
rules_added: 动手前读完 mysqltest/README.md、STDIO_PROTOCOL.md、mysqltest/manifest.json 与全部 cases/*.test、*.result
把题包「正式验收要求仍然公开」逐条抄成可勾选清单，先有清单再写代码
禁止预存样例答案，禁止按用例 id / 表名 / 行数做特判

trigger.detail: 题包明确写明「请实现正常执行与错误处理，而非预存样例答案」，并区分公开样例与正式准入。

versions.title: 失败语句整条不生效
rules_added: 多行 INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE 中任何一行出错，整条语句的行级改动全部撤销
显式事务中该语句之前的成功修改仍可提交或回滚
自动提交模式下失败语句的行既不留在表里也不进入 WAL
原子性要分自动提交、显式事务中、崩溃之后三种情况分别验证

trigger.detail: 用组织方未修改的 protocol_check/run.py 与 _assertions.py 驱动另一套独立实现时，transaction_failed_insert 报出 rows: [[1], [2], [3], [4]] != [[1], [2], [3]]；失败的多行 INSERT 把前一行留在了表里。

versions.student_involvement: The defect was found and fixed by the assistant. No additional student explanation is claimed.

versions.title: 公开用例通过不等于正式准入
rules_added: 公开 20 组用例只是回归基线；正式验收 29 个用例，组织方另保留 9 个用例的输入与操作序列
题包正文里有、公开用例没覆盖的功能要求照样要实现
失败响应的 error.code 必须是稳定的语义名，不能是随手写的措辞

trigger.detail: 题包写明「公开样例通过不代表完整功能准入通过」「隐藏的是测试数据，而非功能要求」。

versions.title: 协议以判题器实际行为为准
rules_added: 启动完成恢复后主动输出一行 {"type":"ready"} 并 flush，且必须在等待第一条请求之前输出
每个请求恰好一个响应，原样回传请求 id（含 JSON 类型），ok 必须是 JSON 布尔值
每条输出一个物理行并立即 flush；stdout 只有协议报文，日志写 stderr
不得把整行 JSON 当 SQL，不得用分号切原始输入
shutdown 响应之后 stdout 不得再有任何内容，退出码 0
Docker 默认入口就是 stdin/stdout 模式，不依赖判题器补传私有参数

trigger.detail: 自研的 development stdio 协议在正式协议面前是错的：握手对象不匹配、请求是 SQL 文本而不是 JSON、响应字段名不同。

versions.title: 数值序列化必须字节级一致
rules_added: 浮点输出用 std::to_chars 的 17 位有效数字与固定 64 字节缓冲
覆盖有符号零、次正规数、数值极值与 BIGINT 边界的字节回归
BIGINT 走 JSON 整数，不能转字符串也不能经浮点丢精度

trigger.detail: 浮点输出格式与判题器的字节结果不一致；同一程序自身的噪声必须先被测量出来，否则无法区分格式差异与运行噪声。

versions.title: 位置化文件读与异常读单独验证
rules_added: 文件读使用原生位置化操作，不用流式读取的隐式偏移
短读、立即读、超过 4 GiB 的偏移、Linux 上的中断读要单独覆盖
文件 IO 测试作为独立主翻译单元编译，避免警告降级

trigger.detail: 偏移越界、短读与中断读会让精确 TopK 在大数据量下返回错结果，而且不会在小样本上暴露。

versions.title: 索引维护不得破坏事务语义
rules_added: 索引页、行页与目录改动共用同一套页事务、语句保存点、空闲页链表与 redo WAL
插入、更新、删除立即维护索引，包括替换整行记录页的普通列更新
新建索引的发布必须是原子的，索引构建过程中崩溃不能留下半成品
ANN 检索必须满足过滤、有效 ID、无重复与题包规定的召回率

trigger.detail: 索引与事务是两个独立的失效面：索引页写坏了会直接破坏事务语义，而公开小样本用例不覆盖这一点。

cross_implementation_differential.what: The organizer's own protocol_check/run.py and _assertions.py, plus the unmodified public fixture package, were used to drive a second, independent implementation (the local Python reference implementation). Only the process transport was adapted, because the packaged transport selects on pipes with select(), which does not work on Windows; the driver, the assertions, the fixture package and the comparison parameters are unchanged.

failures.cause: L2_DISTANCE (the fixture dialect name) was not implemented
real atomicity defect: a failed multi-row INSERT left the earlier row behind
CREATE VECTOR INDEX is not implemented in the local reference implementation

after_fixes.remaining_failure_reason: The local reference implementation deliberately implements exact TopK only; approximate indexing is declared out of contract in SPEC-006. The submitted implementation covers it and is verified by ci:42611519248 and ci:42819609767.

secondary_findings.detail: sql_unsupported expects ALTER TABLE to fail. The local implementation failed it only because the executor had no ALTER branch at all, while its own SPEC-006 claimed ALTER TABLE support. The requirement was corrected and the rejection is now explicit.
secondary_findings.lesson: A green assertion and a broken specification can coexist; reading only the assertion result hides the mismatch.

secondary_findings.detail: The reference test test_topk_works_without_numpy blocked numpy with the find_module import hook, which Python 3.12 removed. On 3.12 numpy was never blocked, so the pure-Python fallback path was no longer being verified while the test stayed green.
secondary_findings.lesson: A green test can also have stopped checking what it claims to check.

cross_implementation_differential.student_involvement: The differential run, the fixes and the re-verification were performed by the assistant. No additional student experiment or explanation is claimed.

limitations: The public fixture package covers 20 of the 29 formal cases. Formal acceptance is the organizer's judgement and is not claimed here.

The contest branch CI runs execute the organizer's unchanged protocol_check/run.py inside the built image; the local differential run drives a different implementation on Windows with an adapted transport layer.
Performance scores were not measured in this material and are not claimed.
Only the quoted student explanation of filter-first TopK is evidence of student understanding; implementation, validation and fixes were performed by the assistant or coordinated automated execution.
No credentials, account information, private endpoints or local absolute paths are included in this material.
